scripts.build: next build && node -e "const fs=require('node:fs'); fs.cpSync('.next/static', '.next/standalone/.next/static', { recursive: true }); fs.cpSync('public', '.next/standalone/public', { recursive: true })" && esbuild scripts/seed.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node22 --format=esm --packages=external --outfile=.next/standalone/scripts/seed.mjs
